headings: Package ownership lands before the CLI switch.
Two homes, one active CLI
Two homes, one active CLI
Stabilize and freeze 38 CLI copies; the active CLI stays on them.
Stage package mechanisms; stabilize and freeze 38 active CLI copies.
Package folders own mechanisms; no internal production dependencies.
Group existing mechanisms by owner; the package has no internal production dependency.
Remove policy-testing export, its lint gate and related tests.
Remove policy-testing export, its lint gate and the associated tests.
Freeze hash normalizes CRLF, still detects source edits.
Normalize CRLF before the 38-file source hash; still reject content changes.
A narrow public doorway
A narrow public doorway
Node-free host types; executor/environment inputs; runtime loads at construction.
Keep host types Node-free; load the runtime dynamically at construction.
Host supplies readiness command; startup runs it cold, telemetry off.
The host supplies the readiness command; startup executes it with cold mode and telemetry off.
Reuse controls; separate status timeout; disabled status/stop and errors reach host.
Reuse lifecycle composition; separate status timeouts; disabled status/stop and errors reach the host.
New checks: exports, Node-free types, side-effect-only entries.
Lock public exports, Node-free declarations and side-effect-only entries with new boundary tests.
Choose once; own the result
Choose once; own the result
Lazy, memoized guards: present → not starting → version → responsive.
Run lazy guards in order: present → not starting → version → responsive; first result stops.
Preserve routes; fresh local executors; warm-up runs independently.
Preserve local/warm routes; make fresh local executors and trigger warm-up independently.
Only safe failures retry locally. Uncertain/accepted work is not replayed.
Retry locally only when transport says safe; uncertain or accepted work is never replayed.
Own capture, spool codec and controlled errors; dispose malformed output.
Own capture, spool codec and controlled failures; dispose malformed warm output.
Private process owners
Private process owners
Validate coordinates before composition; reuse the supplied endpoint.
Adopt validated process coordinates before creating collaborators; reuse their endpoint.
One registry ownership predicate; narrow queries and full mutation checks.
Make the registry the one startup-ownership authority, with narrow and full-snapshot checks.
Separate protocol/instance and token paths, including control exceptions.
Keep distinct authentication paths: normal protocol/instance checks, execution tokens, special control tokens.
Keep execution, delivery, worker, resource and activity owners; bind callbacks.
Keep execution, delivery, workers, resources and activity as separate owners; wire callbacks without invoking them.
Package process/worker entries load the injected executor; no entry API.
Launch real package process/worker entries; load the host executor by URL; entries export no API.
New clock owner, old deadlines
New clock owner, old deadlines
Daemon owns injectable wall/monotonic sources for timestamps and durations.
Use an injectable daemon wall/monotonic clock across timestamps, deadlines and durations.
Idle still starts at construction, resets at acceptance. Readiness/completion fixes deferred.
Keep idle time armed at construction and reset at acceptance; readiness/completion changes stay deferred.
The evidence moves too
The evidence moves too
37 tests move; generic fixtures and built entries replace CLI coupling.
Relocate 37 mechanism test files; use generic package fixtures and built entries instead of CLI coupling.
Worker/CLI version rejection becomes a direct factory test.
Re-anchor CLI version rejection at the executor factory; remove the worker-level CLI mismatch test.
Generic readiness drops CLI startup/result timing assertions.
Drop CLI readiness timing assertions when switching to the generic worker fixture.
Windows forced-exit cleanup uses an observer; diagnostic absent.
Model Windows forced-exit cleanup as observer-owned, with no process-termination diagnostic.
Disable parallel test files in the daemon's Vitest configuration.
Disable file parallelism for the daemon package's Vitest suite.
Add tsx and lockfile entry for moved TypeScript test helpers.
Add tsx as a daemon dev dependency for the moved TypeScript helper processes.
